mapper.select: SELECT id, code, name, province_code AS provinceCode, province_name AS provinceName, is_default AS isDefault FROM city WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY is_default DESC, sort ASC, id ASC
SELECT id, code, name, province_code AS provinceCode, province_name AS provinceName, is_default AS isDefault FROM city WHERE status = 1 AND code = #{code} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, code, name, province_code AS provinceCode, province_name AS provinceName, is_default AS isDefault FROM city WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY is_default DESC, sort ASC, id ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT id, code, name, icon, description, parent_id AS parentId, sort FROM category WHERE biz_type = 'HERITAGE' AND status = 1 ORDER BY sort ASC, id ASC
SELECT id, code, name, sort FROM heritage_level WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY sort ASC, id ASC
SELECT id, title, image, link, link_type AS linkType, sort FROM banner WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY sort ASC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, display_name AS displayName, portrait, profile, skill_type AS skillType, region_code AS regionCode FROM inheritor WHERE audit_status = 1 AND status = 1 AND display_status = 1 AND is_recommend = 1 ORDER BY recommend_sort ASC, published_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.id, p.name, p.cover, p.description AS summary, p.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS category, p.price, p.original_price AS originalPrice, p.sales FROM product p LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE p.status = 1 AND p.is_recommend = 1 ORDER BY p.sales DESC, p.create_time DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, title, cover, content AS summary, category, author, source, create_time AS createTime FROM news WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY is_top DESC, create_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
